rows.what_the_ink_shows: In the corollary, the first line has “affines sur k”; the following line ends the anti-equivalence phrase with “celle des algèbres sur A”. The disputed letter is a capital A with two sloping legs and a crossbar, visibly different from the preceding k (crops/161-4_scan024_L1148.jpg). It is not crossed out or replaced.
rows.note: Preserve the literal A. The row’s k is a mathematical correction of the author’s base-ring wording, not an optical correction. No equivalence between affine objects and algebras was independently proved.

events.type: used and rechecked in this run
events.outcome: Compared the actual original “algèbres sur A” with the enlarged capital A and the local k in the preceding line. The ink agrees with A; no mathematical equivalence was verified.
